import pytest

import humanize


@pytest.mark.parametrize("value, expected", [
    (4.9999999, "5"),
    (0.9999999, "1"),
    (-1.9999999, "-2"),
    (7.99999999, "8"),
    ("5.9999999", "6"),
])
def test_near_whole_rounds_up(value, expected):
    assert humanize.fractional(value) == expected
